rows: A bachelor's degree of at least three years with Mathematics or Statistics as a subject, or a BE/BTech, with 60% (55% for SC/ST/PwD). Final-year students can apply.
NIMCET 2026 was on 6 June 2026 for about 1,300 seats at 11 NITs and 2 IIITs. A BSc with maths is the natural entry. The 2027 brochure was not out at the time of writing.
The official step 2027 table lets you appear in the third year of a three-year BSc or after completing it.

step 2027 registration closes on 5 October 2026 (12 October with a late fee) and the papers run from 6 to 21 February 2027. Appearing is not the same as being hired: engineering-post PSU advertisements and many M.Tech seats name BE/BTech, so read each notice before you plan around a step score.
